messages:
Alex M.: hey team — heads up, my flight got delayed; need to swap primary for the 22:00-02:00 UTC window tonight. I can stay until ~21:45 but can't cover the overnight ramp. Can someone confirm they can take primary? :airplane:
Jess K.: I can take primary from 22:00-02:00 UTC. fine to shadow handoff at 21:50? :+1:
Priya S.: I can be secondary/backup for the same window. I’ll stay on watch until 02:30 if anything spills over.
Marco R.: quick Q — any active pagers or ongoing customer-impacting incidents atm? don’t want to inherit hot state.
Alex M.: no open P0s. had a transient embeds latency spike earlier but it resolved; I ran the fix in the runbook and left notes. See runbook section: https://redwood.runbooks/embeds#latency-spike
Lina (ops-bot): incident-bot: No active incidents. Pager rota shows Alex M. primary until 22:00 UTC, Jess K. on-call candidate.
Wei T.: small ask — if Jess is primary can you switch the dedicated fallback policy in the console to EU-only for that window? we have a scheduled infra maintenance in us-west 23:00-23:30 and want to avoid region failovers.
Jess K.: yep I can set the routing policy. I’ll change it at 21:55 and confirm after.
Alex M.: runbook handoff snippet I usually paste into threads — leaving it here for quick copy:
```
Oncall handoff checklist:
- confirm primary/secondary identities
- check open incidents/pagers: `incident-bot status`
- export traces: `rbx traces --last 2h > traces.json`
- update routing policy if needed in Console > Routing > Temporary overrides
- leave escalation contact: PagerDuty group "embeds-core"
```
Priya S.: copied the checklist. Jess + I will run through it at 21:50.
Jess K.: changing routing override now. Console shows "EU-prefer" override active until 02:00 UTC. I'll annotate the route in the handoff doc. :white_check_mark:
Marco R.: one more note — if you get a token-density surge, enable KV cache bypass per runbook step 4 to reduce cold-start impact. saved me last month.
Jess K.: got it, noted. Priya do you want me to tag you on any page alerts or handle initial triage?
Priya S.: tag me on pages, I’ll take any alerts that look like region-specific failures.
Lina (ops-bot): deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance reminder: us-west infra maintenance at 2025-03-14T23:00:00Z. Affected services: dedicated-GPU pools (expected 30m).
Alex M.: thanks ops-bot. Jess — I'll leave a short handoff doc in Confluence with sequence of actions and where I left the traces. Link: https://confluence/redwood/oncall/handoffs/alex-2025-03-14
Jess K.: I’ll do a short live check at 21:55 (latency, token errors, pager channel) and post a brief final ack here when primary is fully transferred.
Jess K.: 22:01 UTC — confirmed primary role assumed. Pager route verified and routing override active. Leaving shadow channel open for Priya and Marco.
Priya S.: acked. I'll monitor pager and logs until 02:30. Ping me if anything looks odd.
Marco R.: thanks all — leaving a quick pointer in case of customer-facing errors: run quick fix template for noisy embeddings errors — `scripts/quick_restart_embeddings.sh` (2 min) and post to #support if you escalate.
Alex M.: huge thanks to Jess & Priya for the cover. I’m reachable by DM if anything escalates. :pray:
Lina (ops-bot): handoff-logger: Handoff recorded: from Alex M. (primary) to Jess K. (primary) at 1778890860. Secondary: Priya S.. Notes: routing override EU-prefer active until 02:00 UTC.
